name: Abkhaz
notes: Abkhaz (аҧсуа бызшәа), NORTHWEST CAUCASIAN, Cyrillic, ~190k (Abkhazia) — Northwest Caucasian. A Cyrillic base+modifier scan (src/languages/abkhaz/). ★★ HALLMARK = ONE OF THE WORLD'S LARGEST CONSONANT INVENTORIES (~58: labialized/palatalized/pharyngealized/ejective) + only TWO vowels (а→[a], ы→[ə]). Modifiers: ⟨ь⟩ palatalizes (гь→c), ⟨ә⟩ labializes (гә→ɡʷ, аҟәа→aqʼʷa), ⟨'⟩ pharyngealizes (х'→χˤ). THREE-WAY stops voiced/aspirated/ejective г қ к→ɡ kʰ kʼ, etc.; uvular ҟ→qʼ, pharyngeal ҳ→ħ, + extended letters. 80.6% FOLDED / ~93% symbol vs wikipron abk_cyrl_broad (HUMAN, 205) + 69.1%/~93% symbol vs kaikki (979); ҩ→ɥˤ per the word corpus (~12:1) costs 4 def/numeral rows on the primary, gains ~35 on kaikki. ★ folded dragged by referee inconsistency (letter-defs vs words: гә kʷ~ɡʷ, хә ʍ~χʷ, ҩ ɥ~ɥˤ) + phonemic i=əj/u=əw rows + numeral -ба→pa devoicing; consonant SYSTEM verified (аҷкәын→at͡ʃʼkʼʷən). 🔷 single-source-family (partly reference-parity on the letter-defs). Deferred: the phonemic i=əj/u=əw tail, numeral devoicing, stress.

name: Afrikaans
notes: Standard Afrikaans, Latin + diacritics. GREEDY digraph-first g2p + Germanic OPEN/CLOSED-SYLLABLE vowel-length rule (single vowel LONG in open syll V.CV, SHORT in closed VC#/VCC — engine lookahead) + DEVOICING (b→p,d→t) word-finally, REGRESSIVELY before a voiceless obstruent, and at the MORPHEME SEAM (a vowel-initial suffix resyllabifies and blocks it — send·ing sɛndəŋ; a seam ⟨d⟩ degeminates against /t d/ — veld·tog fɛltɔχ, land·dros landrɔs) + geminate collapse + first-syllable stress past unstressed prefixes. Signatures: g=[χ] fricative, w=[v], v=[f], h=[ɦ]; long mids = CENTERING DIPHTHONGS ee/open-e=iə, oo/open-o=uə; y=[əi], ui=[œy], dim -tjie=[ki]. 79.5% FOLDED / 94.7% symbol vs en.wiktionary (2220, HUMAN) and **65.2% / 93.9% vs the RCRL Afrikaans Pronunciation Dictionary (27428, CTexT/NWU via ttslab/za_lex, CC BY-SA 2.5 ZA)** — af is NO LONGER SINGLE-SOURCE: RCRL has no Wiktionary lineage, unlike wikipron afr which turned out to be the same en.wiktionary scrape as the primary. The second source immediately settled what one could not: the morpheme-initial Cw ONSET is the glide [w] (RCRL 260:1 across sw/dw/tw/kw) where en.wiktionary is a 10:9 coin flip — the engine rule tried and rejected in Run 4 as referee inconsistency was right all along. It also corroborates -ig=ə (474:7), initial v=[f] (2363:69) and final-d devoicing (1608:7) — the GENERATIVE number: the eval scores phonemizeWordRules, since the 44-entry proper-noun lexicon (af-lexicon.tsv) is built from this same single referee and improves the SHIPPED path only. TWO-SOURCE (en.wiktionary primary + RCRL secondary, independent lineages). Numbers IMPLEMENTED (unit-en-ten compositor); nasalization deferred with evidence (visible n-deletion class ×2/2220; lexicon carries afrikɑ̃ːs). ⚠ THE UNSTRESSED-**OPEN** VOWEL CELL is now modelled (`unstressedOpen`), DERIVED from the secondary's 25,247 stress-and-syllable-annotated words: 17 of 20 vowel cells confirmed the manifest, ⟨o⟩ ɔ→u and ⟨u⟩ œ→y corrected, ⟨i⟩ rejected because the INDEPENDENT primary said −9 (deriving from a referee and scoring on it is circular). ⚠ SHIPPED LEXICON since #776: af-rcrl-lexicon.tsv, 25,112 RCRL entries serving phonemizeWord (NOT phonemizeWordRules, which the eval scores — the eval numbers are byte-identical before and after). It covers 86.2% of running-text TOKENS and takes those from 87.4% to 99.5% exact, ≈10.5pp of everything read aloud — the rules' 79.5% is a DICTIONARY-shaped number and real-text quality was always higher. ⚠ THE '~45 WORDS' STRESS BOUND WAS AN ARTEFACT OF A 554-ROW SAMPLE and is retired: re-run against the secondary the oracle covers 23,388 rows and is worth +1189 (4.3pp), ~26x. Placement is 72.6% and falls with length (88% at 2 syllables, 36% at 8). `stressFromEnd`, a DERIVED suffix→syllables-from-end table (held-out 72.7% → 74.9%), takes +82 with the primary flat; ⟨tig⟩ is excluded by name because the -tig numerals are a closed initially-stressed class it would wreck. SEAM VOICING DONE (+10) and smaller than billed: the f→v half is word-initial ⟨v⟩ referee noise (184 [f] vs 13 [v]), not a seam, and unfoldable since ⟨w⟩=[v] contrasts. What remains of d↔t is COMPOUND SPLITTING — erd·wolf/hand·haaf/noord·waarts/band·opnemer never split, so there is no seam for the rule to fire at. ⚠ A 3-letter-head exception list was built for that and REJECTED: +9/−0 on the referee but 143 changed words in the 53k stem list, most for the worse (reg·ter, ent·jie, sit·ting, bos·sie), because sit·ting must degeminate and groot·toon must not and the splitter cannot tell them apart. Run 7. Taxonomy in docs/afrikaans_stress_investigation.md.

name: Aragonese
notes: Aragonese (aragonés), Ibero-Romance (Pyrenean), ~25k (Aragon/NE Spain), Latin — a Spanish-shaped shallow g2p (the Asturian/Galician reuse-the-Spanish-engine pattern; self-contained manifest+scan). ★ THE ARAGONESE HALLMARKS: ⟨ch⟩→[t͡ʃ] (where Spanish has [x]: Chesús→t͡ʃesus, chuego→t͡ʃweɡo), ⟨ny⟩→[ɲ] (the Catalan-style digraph: Espanya→espaɲa), ⟨x⟩→[ʃ] (baxo→baʃo), ⟨ll⟩→[ʎ], ⟨v⟩→[b] (betacism); DISTINCIÓN ⟨z⟩/⟨c+e,i⟩→[θ] (seseo [s] the marked minority, folded); ⟨j⟩/⟨g+e,i⟩→[x]; ★ WORD-FINAL ⟨-r⟩ APOCOPE (documented, shared with Catalan/Occitan: cantar→kanta, muller→muʎe); single ⟨r⟩→[ɾ] tap vs ⟨rr⟩/word-initial→[r] trill; rising glides ⟨i⟩→[j]/⟨u⟩→[w]; ⟨qu gu⟩→[k ɡ]/[kw ɡw]. 76.2% FOLDED / 96.2% symbol vs wikipron arg_latn_broad (HUMAN, 1320) — the 96.2% SYMBOL is the honest headline; the folded number is deflated by the FINAL-R DUAL FORMS (the referee attests both the dropped and the spelling form for each infinitive → ~150 forced misses), the seseo/distinción split, and the spirantization allophony (all folded). Verified exact on common words (Chesús→t͡ʃesus, Espanya→espaɲa, tierra→tjera, Aragón→aɾaɡon). 🔷 single-source family (wikipron; kaikki same source) but a shallow orthography. Deferred: stress, numbers, the ⟨tz⟩/learned-⟨cc⟩ minority, a spirantization pass.

name: Asturian
notes: Astur-Leonese (Ibero-Romance), Asturias/NW Spain (~110k). Added for FLEURS. Close to Spanish/Galician (distinción c/z→[θ]). Greedy Ibero-Romance scan: the Asturian hallmark ⟨x⟩→[ʃ] (Asturian writes ⟨x⟩ for the fricative → ⟨g⟩ stays [ɡ], ⟨j⟩→[h]); ⟨ll⟩→ʎ ⟨ñ⟩→ɲ ⟨ch⟩→t͡ʃ ⟨y⟩→ʝ(onset)/[i](coda) ⟨v⟩→b; ⟨qu gu⟩→[k ɡ]/[ɡw]; rising glides i→j u→w; ⟨pt ct⟩→[t]; Western dialect letters ⟨ḥ⟩→h ⟨ḷḷ⟩→t͡ʂ (che vaqueira); tap ⟨r⟩→ɾ vs trill ⟨rr⟩/initial→r. NO final-consonant deletion. 99.0% FOLDED / 99.8% symbol vs wikipron ast_latn_broad (4170 human; 97.6% first pass). Folds: stress (unmarked), spirantization β/ð/ɣ→b/d/ɡ, rhotic tap/trill. Residual = stress-conditioned hiatus glides (Llión→ʎion) + loan finals + letter-name rows. 🔷 single source. Deferred: stress/hiatus model, numbers.

name: Chuvash
notes: Chuvash (Чӑвашла / Чӑваш чӗлхи), the SOLE surviving Oghur (Bulgaric) Turkic language — the deepest split in Turkic (sister to every Common-Turkic language: tr/az/tk/tt/ba/kk), ~1M (Chuvashia, Russia), CYRILLIC. A Cyrillic grapheme scan with two Chuvash signatures. ★★ HALLMARK 1 = ALLOPHONIC VOICING: Chuvash has NO phonemic voicing contrast — the voiceless letters п т к ч с ҫ ш х voice to [b d ɡ d͡ʑ z ʑ ʐ ɣ] between vowels, after a nasal/glide ⟨н м й⟩, or after a liquid ⟨р л⟩ before a FULL vowel (апат→aˈbat, ача→aˈd͡ʑa, манпа→manˈba, вӑлсем→ʋəlˈzem); a GEMINATE blocks it → single long [Cː] (иккӗ→ˈikːɘ). ★★ HALLMARK 2 = REDUCED-VOWEL STRESS: the reduced vowels ӑ→[ə], ӗ→[ɘ] cannot bear stress — it falls on the last FULL vowel, else the first (чӑваш→t͡ɕəˈʋaʂ, сӑмах→səˈmaχ, vs вӑтӑр→ˈʋədər). ⟨в⟩→ʋ, ⟨х⟩→χ, ⟨ҫ⟩→ɕ; iotation. 92.9% FOLDED / 97.9% symbol vs English Wiktionary "Chuvash terms with IPA pronunciation" (84 LITERAL human {{IPA|cv|…}} pairs — real attestation, not module-generated; scraped via the MediaWiki API — no wikipron/epitran chv). Folds: the reduced-vowel breve (ŏ→ə preFold), w~ʋ, palatalization ʲ (referee-inconsistent), sibilant place, x~χ / q~k backness, parenthetical optional segments. Residual = the referee's own inconsistencies (liquid-triggered voicing, ə~ɘ swaps). 🔷 single-source (thin 84 but HUMAN → a real quality signal). Deferred: numbers, a Russian-loan lexicon, the Viryal dialect.

name: Bashkir
notes: Bashkir (Башҡорт теле), Kipchak Turkic (sibling of Tatar), ~1.4M (Bashkortostan), CYRILLIC — Cyrillic grapheme scan. HALLMARK = the INTERDENTAL fricatives ҫ→[θ], ҙ→[ð] (shared with Turkmen). Unlike Tatar, Bashkir WRITES the uvulars ҡ→[q], ғ→[ʁ] (к→k, г→ɡ always — no harmony inference). Bashkir VOWEL SHIFT: о→[ʊ], ө→[ʏ], ы→[ɯ], е→[ɪ]/[jɪ], ә→æ, ү→ɵ; dark л→[ɫ] (back harmony); у/ү→[w] after a vowel. ★ REFEREE-LIMITED (Tatar situation): kaikki Bashkir (2395) is HEAVILY Russian-LOAN-polluted (Russian-style pronunciation) → folded % is dragged (40.8% full; native g2p ~71% on non-detected-loan words, verified correct on goldens: башҡорт→bɑʂqʊɾt, аҫыл→ɑθɯɫ). ★ Real Bashkir text is loan-heavy → the SHIPPED phonemizer DETECTS Russian loans (vowel-harmony violation) and routes them to the ru g2p (Bashkir reads loans Russian-style). 🔷 single-source-family (kaikki+wikipron; no epitran). Deferred: numbers, loan lexicon, 2nd referee.

name: Balochi (Southern)
notes: Southern Balochi, CROSS-SCRIPT (Arabic + Roman). Authored from Jahani & Korn (2009) + Korn (2005a). Cross-script LEXICON (balochi-lexicon.tsv, 399 words: 55 curated + 344 from Korn Etymological Index; ASJP-corroborated) recovers the vowels the Arabic abjad loses (short a/i/u unwritten + و/ی conflate uː/oː, iː/eː); Roman orthography is phonemic. Independent referee = ASJP Southern-Balochi bcc (CC0, coarse ~40w) corroborates the inventory ~97%. Fills the RETROFLEX-Iranian gap (ʈ ɖ ɽ vs dental t̪ d̪; ق->k; unaspirated). Arabic-OOV still skeleton-defective (⛔ tail); lexicon+Roman full-voweled. 🔷 single-referee-family.

name: Bavarian
notes: Austro-Bavarian (Upper German), Austria/Bavaria/S Tyrol (~14M L1). CONTESTED: mainstream sources treat it as a German dialect; it has NO codified orthography (spelled ad hoc) — the g2p targets the de-facto Bavarian-Wikipedia convention (⟨å⟩→ɔ, ⟨ä ö ü ß⟩) that wikipron transcribes. 60.4% folded / 89.9% symbol vs wikipron bar_latn_broad (1380). Story = the Austro-Bavarian fortis/lenis neutralization (⟨t p k⟩→lenis d̥ b̥ ɡ̥) + falling diphthongs ⟨ia ua oa⟩. 🔷 single-source, Afrikaans-tier.

name: Belarusian
notes: East Slavic, Cyrillic, sibling of Ukrainian. Cleanroom RULE g2p (src/languages/belarusian/, mirrors the uk iotated/palatalisation engine): akanne is SPELLED (о only stressed -> [o]) so no stress dict. Signatures: г->ɣ, retroflex ж/ш/ч->ʐ/ʂ/t͡ʂ (+ дж->d͡ʐ, дз->d͡z), unique ў->u̯/w, і IOTATED (Іван->jivan, unlike uk), э->ɛ vs soft е->(j)e, dark л->ɫ, palatalisation before ь/і/iotated, and — unlike uk — regressive VOICING + final devoicing (горад->ɣorat). REGRESSIVE PALATALISATION (sibilant с/з/ц/дз softens before a palatalised coronal/labial, not velar; н->nʲ before a palatalised affricate) was the iterative lever 90.9%->97.2%. Slavic-decimal numbers. 97.2% FOLDED vs wikipron bel_cyrl_narrow (HUMAN, 7259); residual = loanword г->[ɡ] tail (Ghana/Riga) + rare clusters.

name: Tibetan
notes: Standard/Lhasa Tibetan, Tibetan script, ~1.2M Lhasa speakers — Bodish/Tibetic. ONE OF THE DEEPEST orthographies in the world (Classical spelling encodes Old Tibetan) → a syllable-stack RULE ENGINE (Unicode full vs subjoined → prefix·superscript·root·subscript·vowel·suffix): TONOGENESIS (voiceless→HIGH ˥, voiced-obstruent→LOW ˩+aspiration, sonorant raised by prefix/superscript), silent prefixes/superscripts (རྟ→ta˥), onset clusters (ya-btags→palatal ཁྱི→kʲʰi, ra-btags→retroflex affricate ཁྲག→ʈ͡ʂʰaʔ, ལྷ→ɬa), suffix VOWEL UMLAUT a→ɛ o→ø u→y + LENGTH + NASALIZATION + GLOTTALIZATION (བོད→pʰøʔ˩, གSAL→sɛː˥), Lhasa word-tone template (non-initial syllable defaults HIGH). PRIMARY = hand-curated JIPA 'Central Tibetan (Lhasa)' illustration (Zhang 2024, CC-BY, INDEPENDENT, 40): 100% folded / 100% symbol. Independent COVERAGE = 100% of 299,733 TIBMD@MUC (OpenSLR, non-Wiktionary) Lhasa syllable tokens. SECONDARY = kaikki Lhasa 1281 (Module:bo-pron OUTPUT → reference-parity, disclosed): 63.9% / 89.6% symbol. Deferred: Kham/Amdo reading traditions. 🔷 independent human anchor (small) + independent coverage (large) + reference-parity bulk.

name: Bishnupriya Manipuri
notes: Bishnupriya Manipuri (বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মণিপুরী / ইমার ঠার), Eastern Indo-Aryan (~120k, Assam/Tripura in India + Sylhet division of Bangladesh), Bengali / Eastern-Nagari abugida. Contact-shaped by Meitei but structurally Eastern Indic — a 4th Eastern-Nagari member alongside Bengali (bn), Assamese (as), Sylheti (syl). Reuses the Bengali G2P engine (makeNativeBengali — the shared abugida scan + inherent-vowel deletion + geminate→length) with a Bishnupriya manifest whose values are BENGALI, not Assamese: the referee is Bengali-like — the three sibilants শ/ষ/স→[ʃ] (সাত→ʃat̪, বিশ→biʃ), the affricates চ/ছ/জ→[t͡ʃ t͡ʃʰ d͡ʒ] KEPT (চার→t͡ʃaɾ, হাজার→ɦad͡ʒaɾ), and the retroflex/dental split KEPT (ট→ʈ আট→aʈ vs ত→t̪ তিন→t̪in). The ONE divergence from Bengali proper is heightHarmony:false — the inherent /ɔ/ does NOT raise before a following high vowel (সমুদ্র→ʃɔmud̪ɾo, not ʃomudɾo); medial + final inherent-vowel deletion behave as Bengali (খরগোশ→kʰɔɾɡoʃ, ফল→pʰɔl). 84.2% FOLDED / 95.1% symbol vs the English-Wiktionary "Bishnupriya Manipuri terms with IPA pronunciation" category (the ONLY referee — no wikipron/kaikki/epitran bpy; 38 pairs via the MediaWiki API, HUMAN {{IPA|bpy|…}}, ~9 of them single-letter vowel definitions = reference-parity). Folds: the referee's retroflex-tinged affricate ⟨ʈʃ⟩→t͡ʃ, rhotic r~ɾ, geminate CC (দিল্লী), voiced-breathy dʰ~dʱ, the post-vocalic glide→offglide j~i (ছয়→t͡ʃʰɔi), the glottal h~ɦ (পাহাড়), ɪ~i / ʊ~u / ɑ~a. Residual (6, all 1×) = a spelling variant (কঁঠাল read as কাঁঠাল), the referee's [o]-raising of a RETAINED medial inherent (বছর→bɔt͡ʃʰor — not Bengali height harmony), a compound-boundary schwa retention (ভালবাসা), an intervocalic র→[ɽ] flap (বারো). 🔷 single-source, THIN (38 pairs, ~29 real) — the % is a real signal on a small HUMAN sample, not a breadth claim. Deferred: numbers, a second referee, the retained-inherent [o] micro-rule.

notes: Eastern Min / Fuzhounese (Fuzhou), Fujian (~9M) — the only absent major Sinitic branch. name: Cherokee
pr: Cherokee (ᏣᎳᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ), Iroquoian, ~2k L1 (Oklahoma/NC) — THE FLEET'S FIRST IROQUOIAN language (a new family). Written in the CHEROKEE SYLLABARY (Sequoyah, 85 chars, U+13A0–U+13F5 + Supplement). AUTHORED from Montgomery-Anderson, *A Reference Grammar of Oklahoma*. A deterministic per-character lookup over the 85-char syllabary (Table 13): each char → its CV IPA. ★ 6 vowels a e i o u + ⟨v⟩→[ə̃] (nasal mid-central). Obstruents PHONEMICALLY VOICELESS (Cherokee contrasts ASPIRATION, not voicing): g/d/ts/tl/qu series → unaspirated [k t t͡s t͡ɬ kʷ]; aspirated split-cells (Ꭷ→kʰ, Ꮤ/Ꮦ/Ꮨ→tʰ) → the richer form; bare Ꮝ=/s/. ★★ THE SYLLABARY IS A SHALLOW PHONEMIC SKELETON (grammar §4): it marks NO aspiration/tone/length/glottal/intrusive-h — the engine recovers the SEGMENTAL melody only; the 6 tones, length, aspiration, glottalisation, intrusive-h are the folded residual (Scottish-Gaelic/Faroese pattern in the extreme — SYMBOL accuracy is the honest headline). TWO corroborating HUMAN referees: wikipron chr_cher_broad (183) 91.8% folded / 97.3% symbol + kaikki (179) 92.2% / 97.3%. The ~9% residual is the grammar's morphophonological vowel-deletion (the syllabary preserves the underlying vowel, speech deletes it — the "kolhka" case) + fine allophony, none recoverable from the syllabary. 🔷 well-resourced, two human referees. Deferred: the vowel-deletion morphophonology, tone/length lexicon, the Latin romanization front-end, numbers.

name: Crimean Tatar
notes: Crimean Tatar (qırımtatar tili), KIPCHAK+OGHUZ Turkic, ~540k (Crimea + diaspora), the Turkish-based LATIN alphabet (highly phonemic, NO digraphs — ç ş ñ ğ are single letters). A greedy grapheme scan + gemination + final stress (src/languages/crimeantatar/). THE ORTHOGRAPHY WRITES the uvular/velar choice: uvular q→[q] / voiced dorsal ğ→[ɣ] vs velar k g; the front/back HARMONY vowels a o u ı→[ɑ o u ɯ] vs e ö ü i→[e ø y i]; c→[d͡ʒ], ç→[t͡ʃ], ş→[ʃ], ñ→[ŋ], j→[ʒ], y→[j], v→[v], h→[h]; â→[a]; doubled letter → [Cː]/[Vː] (yollamaq→jolːɑmɑq). ★ Turkish-I casing (dotless I→[ɯ]→ı, dotted İ→[i]; both in TOKEN — Qırım→qɯˈrɯm). 94.4% FOLDED / 98.9% symbol (17/18) but on a TINY 18-word referee (English Wiktionary 'Crimean Tatar terms with IPA pronunciation' — ONLY source; no wikipron/kaikki/epitran) → the % confirms the mappings, not broad accuracy. 1 residual = cañı where the referee wrote ñ as [n] (standard ñ=[ŋ] → ours correct). Verified on goldens (qırımtatar→qɯrɯmtɑˈtɑr, çay→ˈt͡ʃɑj). 🔷 THIN single-source. Deferred: numbers, larger referee, Cyrillic front-end.

name: Danish
notes: North Germanic, the DEEPEST European orthography. LEXICON-first: da-lexicon.tsv (7476 words from the en.wiktionary data normalised to canonical IPA + kept stress; CC-BY-SA; build-da-lexicon.mts) -> a perceptron TAGGER (OOV, sync, held-out 45.5% vs the rules' 30.5% on the same split) -> a greedy rule g2p (phonemizeWordRules) as the last-tier fallback. Rule engine: soft-d (d->ð intervocalic/final, [d] before C), af-->aw glide, coda-r->ʁ, final-t-after-vowel->d, -er/-et/-en/-el reductions, silent-h (hj/hv/th), ng->ŋ, first-syllable+unstressed-prefix STRESS model. Referee-eval measures the RULE engine NON-CIRCULARLY = 27.4% FOLDED (the honest novel-word floor; low because Danish vowel quality/reduction/stress is largely LEXICAL). Lexicon covers 97.3% of the referee (common words) at reference quality (Kobenhavn->kob@n'hAwn, gade->'gaeð@). HONEST folds: stod/aspiration/length/dots + a~ɑ (modelling tested, LOST -> noise); ae/e/aa/o qualities KEPT DISTINCT (folding them inflated +8pp). 🟡 bounded — a neural OOV g2p (bn-tagger pattern) is the path past the rule floor. Numbers deferred.

name: Basque
notes: Basque (euskara), a LANGUAGE ISOLATE (no living relatives), Latin script, highly phonemic orthography. A greedy digraph+letter scan (src/languages/basque/). ★★ HALLMARK = the THREE-WAY SIBILANT / affricate system — laminal ⟨z⟩→[s̻] / ⟨tz⟩→[t͡s̻], apical ⟨s⟩→[s̺] / ⟨ts⟩→[t͡s̺], postalveolar ⟨x⟩→[ʃ] / ⟨tx⟩→[t͡ʃ] (zu 'you'→s̻u vs su 'fire'→s̺u — a minimal pair; atzo→at͡s̻o vs hots→ot͡s̺). ★ ⟨r⟩ TAP [ɾ] intervocalic vs TRILL [r] final/precons/doubled (udare→udaɾe, hartu→hartu, herri→heri); palatals ⟨tt dd ll ñ⟩→[c ɟ ʎ ɲ]; ⟨j⟩→[x]; ⟨g⟩→[ɡ] always; ⟨h⟩→[h]. 84.8% FOLDED / 98.0% symbol vs wikipron eus_latn_broad (HUMAN, 20114). The z/s laminal↔apical distinction is western-neutralised + the referee records it inconsistently + the backbone strips the apical/laminal diacritics (both fold to [s]) — we emit the standard three-way canonically (disclosed). NO folds. 🔷 single-source-family (broad+narrow both wikipron; epitran eus-Latn datafile absent). Numbers DONE (VIGESIMAL base-20). i-palatalization + letter-names evaluated-and-rejected (regress / noise).

notes: Uralic (Finnic), near-perfectly PHONEMIC Latin orthography. Authored greedy g2p + code rules (gemination Cː, ng->ŋː, nk->ŋk) — src/languages/finnish/. Signatures: 8 vowels with a=ɑ (BACK), v=ʋ (approximant), r=r (trill); DOUBLING=LENGTH (aa->ɑː) + 18 diphthongs mark the 2nd vowel non-syllabic (au->ɑu̯, uo->uo̯); consonant gradation is already spelled out -> no gradation logic. name: Faroese
notes: Faroese (føroyskt), North Germanic (Insular Scandinavian, sibling of Icelandic), ~72k (Faroe Islands), Latin + ⟨á í ó ú ý æ ø ð⟩ — one of the DEEPEST orthographies in Europe. A self-contained greedy scan whose CORE rule is that vowel LENGTH conditions vowel QUALITY: a stressed vowel is LONG/diphthongal in an OPEN syllable (≤1 following consonant), SHORT/monophthong before a cluster — a→[ɛaː]/[a], á→[ɔɑː]/[ɔ], ó→[ɔuː]/[œ], ú→[ʉuː]/[ʏ], í ý→[ʊiː]/[ʊi]. NO voicing contrast: ⟨b d g⟩→[p t k] (+ pre-aspiration folded). ⟨ð⟩ largely SILENT — intervocalic ⟨ð⟩/⟨g⟩→the [j]/[v]/∅ glide by neighbouring vowel (Eyður→ɛiːjʊɹ front-i wins, dagur→tɛaːvʊɹ round, agað→ɛaːa between ⟨a⟩); ⟨g k⟩→[t͡ʃ] before a front vowel (argi→aɹt͡ʃɪ, not before ⟨ø⟩: gøta→køːta); ⟨tj dj sj⟩→[t͡ʃ d͡ʒ ʃ]; retroflex r-clusters ⟨rn rt rd rs rl⟩→[ɻɳ ʈ ɖ ʂ ɭ]; ⟨ll⟩→[tl]; SKERPING ó→[ɛ]/ú→[ɪ] before ⟨gv⟩ (dúgva→tɪkva); ng-palatalization ⟨n⟩→[ɲ]/[ŋ]+a→[ɛ] (gangi→kɛɲt͡ʃɪ). 57.1% FOLDED / 88.6% symbol vs wikipron fao_latn_broad (HUMAN, 3024). ★ the 88.6% SYMBOL is the honest headline (the Bavarian framing) — the folded number is deflated by proper-noun/loan NON-INITIAL stress (engine assumes native initial stress), the referee's own DIALECTAL MIXING (⟨rn⟩→[tn]~[ɻɳ], ⟨ð⟩→[j]~∅), and fine diphthong-offglide detail; the segmental core is solid. Folds: pre-aspiration ʰ, length ː, round-glide w~v, low-vowel backness ɑ~a. 🔷 single-source family (wikipron; kaikki fao same source) but LARGE. Deferred: numbers, a non-initial-stress lexicon (the Norwegian path), the retroflex/[tn] dialect split, compound stress.

name: Scottish Gaelic
notes: Scottish Gaelic (Gàidhlig), Goidelic Celtic (sibling of Irish), ~57k (Scotland), Latin — a DEEP orthography sharing Irish's BROAD/SLENDER axis ("caol le caol": a consonant is velarized [Cˠ]/dental next to a/o/u, palatalized [Cʲ] next to e/i). A self-contained rule engine (isolated from the lexicon-bound Irish engine, the Faroese-vs-Icelandic pattern). ★★ THE SG HALLMARK = PRE-ASPIRATION: a medial/final fortis ⟨p t c⟩→[hp ht̪ xk] after a vowel/sonorant (mac→maxk, cat→kʰaht̪), de-aspirates after an obstruent (asta→as̪t̪), word-initial→aspirated [pʰ t̪ʰ kʰ]; slender c/t pre-asp→[ç] (aice→açkʲ). ★ ⟨b d g⟩→UNASPIRATED LENIS [p t̪ k] (NOT Irish's voiced); ⟨s⟩→[s̪]/[ʃ]; ⟨l n r⟩→[l̪ˠ n̪ˠ rˠ]/[lʲ ɲ ɾʲ]; lenition bh mh→[v], ch→[x]/[ç], dh gh→[ɣ]/[j], th sh→[h], fh→∅, ph→[f]; ⟨ao⟩→[ɯː]; first-syllable stress + unstressed→[ə]. 15.1% FOLDED / 67.0% symbol vs wikipron gla_latn_broad (HUMAN, 6000). ★ the FOLDED % is a MULTI-DIALECT ARTIFACT (the referee has 4+ transcriptions/word → raw exact 0.3%; the Irish situation but more extreme); SYMBOL accuracy 67.0% is the honest signal (native subset 67.0%, not name-dragged). Reduction + pre-asp + broad/slender all net-positive + spot-checked (mac→maxk EXACT). Folds: velarization ˠ (variably marked; broad/slender survives via dental/ʲ/segment), lenis devoicing-ring b̥/d̪̊/ɡ̊→p/t̪/k, multi-dialect vowel noise. 🔷 single-source family, REFEREE-LIMITED. Deferred: a pronunciation lexicon (the Irish path — semi-lexical ⟨ea ui ao⟩ + a~ə reduction), numbers.

Near-phonemic: 12 vowels (6 oral + 6 NASAL ⟨ã ẽ ĩ õ ũ ỹ⟩; ⟨y⟩→[ɨ]), PRENASALIZED voiced stops ⟨mb nd⟩→[ᵐb ⁿd] (⟨ng⟩ emitted plain [ŋ] — also ~48% variably prenasalized, majority default), glottal ⟨'⟩ (puso)→[ʔ], ⟨ch⟩→[ʃ] ⟨j⟩→[d͡ʒ] ⟨g⟩→[ɰ] ⟨gu⟩→[w]/[ɰ] ⟨ñ⟩→[ɲ] ⟨v⟩→[ʋ] ⟨r⟩→[ɾ]. name: Ancient Greek
notes: Ancient Greek (Ἑλληνική), Hellenic, POLYTONIC Greek script, the reconstructed 5th-c. BCE CLASSICAL ATTIC pronunciation (Allen, Vox Graeca) — the classical counterpart to the Classical-Latin bring-up. A self-contained NFD-based polytonic scan. ★ Vowels α ε η ι ο υ ω→[a e ɛː i o y ɔː] (η/ω long mid, υ→[y]); DIPHTHONGS αι→[ai̯] ει→[eː] οι→[oi̯] αυ→[au̯] ευ→[eu̯] ου→[uː]; iota subscript ᾳ/ῃ/ῳ→long V+[i̯]; diaeresis breaks a diphthong. ★ ASPIRATES θ φ χ→[tʰ pʰ kʰ]; ζ→[zd], ξ→[ks], ψ→[ps]; γ→[ŋ] before a velar or ⟨μ⟩ (ἄγγελος→áŋɡelos); σ→[z] before a voiced consonant (Λέσβια→lézbia); aspirate assimilation πφ/τθ/κχ→[pʰpʰ tʰtʰ kʰkʰ]. ★ ROUGH BREATHING→prefixed [h] (ἵππος→híppos); word-initial ⟨ῥ⟩→[r̥]; PITCH ACCENT emitted. 99.4% FOLDED / 99.7% symbol vs wikipron grc_grek (the {{grc-IPA}} 5th-BCE ATTIC row, 33709 headwords, filtered from the 198k multi-period dump by the pitch-accent marker). Near-ceiling; verified exact incl. accent (λόγος→lóɡos, θεός→tʰeós, ἄνθρωπος→ántʰrɔːpos). ★ HONESTY: the referee is MODULE-GENERATED (Wiktionary grc-IPA) → 🔷 reference-parity-adjacent (like cdo/bo), BUT the reconstruction is the scholarly Allen standard + our rules authored from Allen, not lifted from the module. Deferred: Koine/Byzantine reading traditions (a period param), alphabetic numerals, unmarked-macron length.

name: Hawaiian
notes: Hawaiian (ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi), Austronesian (Eastern Polynesian, sibling of Māori), ~24k (Hawaiʻi), Latin — ONE OF THE SIMPLEST phonologies in the world (the Māori situation). A near-1:1 phonemic single-grapheme scan: 5 vowels /a e i o u/ + the MACRON (kahakō) = LENGTH (ā→aː), and 8 consonants ⟨p k m n l h w⟩ + the ʻOKINA ⟨ʻ⟩→[ʔ] (a full glottal-stop consonant: Hawaiʻi→hawaiʔi, ʻāina→ʔaːina). ★ LOAN-LETTER ADAPTATION: Hawaiian lacks ⟨b c d f g j q r s t v x y z⟩ → loanwords adapt to the nearest phoneme (t→k Aigupita→aikupika, s→k, r→l Doreka→koleka, b→p, d/g→k, v→w). No stress (penultimate, mora-based, unwritten). 98.9% FOLDED / 99.8% symbol on the FIRST pass vs wikipron haw_latn_broad (HUMAN, 2152) — near-ceiling. The ONLY residual is the alphabet LETTER-NAME rows (H→[heː] "hē" — the referee gives letter names, not phonemes; ~12 unmodelable rows). Folds: the diphthong offglide mark. 🔷 single-source family (wikipron; kaikki same source) but a trivially-transparent orthography → among the cleanest in the fleet. Deferred: stress, numbers, the ⟨w⟩→[v] positional realisation.

name: Haitian Creole
notes: French-lexified creole of Haiti (~12M), Latin (the phonemic IPN orthography, Pressoir-Faublas 1979). The 3rd creole in the fleet (after kea + Nigerian Pidgin pcm). Greedy scan + the nasal-vowel rule: ⟨ou⟩→u, ⟨ui⟩→ɥi, ⟨ch⟩→ʃ, ⟨è ò⟩→ɛ ɔ; Haitian ⟨r⟩→[ɣ] (→[w] before a rounded vowel, ayeropò→ajewopɔ), ⟨j⟩→ʒ, ⟨y⟩→j. THE CORE: nasal vowels ⟨an en on⟩→[ã ɛ̃ ɔ̃] syllable-finally (nan→nã, lang→lãɡ), oral before a true vowel (Dominik→dominik), nasal before a glide (anyen→ãjɛ̃), doubled ⟨nn⟩→nasal+n; ⟨i⟩/⟨ou⟩ don't nasalize (machin→maʃin, moun→mun); geminate collapse. 97.7% FOLDED / 99.4% symbol vs wikipron hat_latn_broad (1691 human; 100% first pass). Backbone strips the nasal tilde → nasal comparison is base-vowel; engine emits ã ɛ̃ ɔ̃. Folds: rhotic ɣ~ʁ~ɰ, loan nasals õ→ɔ̃, stress (unmarked). 🔷 single source. notes: Indo-European (own branch), OWN ALPHABET, EASTERN Armenian (Yerevan). Cleanroom left-to-right greedy g2p (src/languages/armenian/). name: Western Armenian
notes: Indo-European (own Armenian branch), OWN ALPHABET, the ISTANBUL/DIASPORA standard (արեւմտահայերէն). SIBLING of Eastern hy, reusing the shared manifest-driven engine (makeArmenianEngine — hy/hyw differ only in the consonant table + digraphs). ★★ SIGNATURE = the WESTERN CONSONANT SHIFT: the classical three-way stop/affricate system collapses to TWO-way — classical VOICED ⟨բ դ գ ձ ջ⟩ AND classical ASPIRATE ⟨փ թ ք ց չ⟩ both → voiceless-aspirated [pʰ tʰ kʰ t͡sʰ t͡ʃʰ] (they MERGE), while classical VOICELESS ⟨պ տ կ ծ ճ⟩ → VOICED [b d ɡ d͡z d͡ʒ] (պատ→bɑd, բարի→pʰɑɾi, փակ→pʰɑɡ, գործ→kʰoɾd͡z, կով→ɡov). RHOTIC NEUTRALISATION ⟨ր ռ⟩→[ɾ] (Eastern keeps ɾ vs trill r); front-rounded ⟨յու/իւ⟩→[ʏ] ⟨յո⟩→[œ] digraphs. 86.8% FOLDED / 97.8% symbol vs wikipron hye_armn_w_broad (HUMAN, 17211) — BEATS Eastern's 82.5% on the same referee style; corroborated by hye_armn_w_narrow (17584, marks the aspiration). 1 fold: aspiration ʰ (broad doesn't transcribe it). 🔷 single-source-family (broad+narrow both wikipron; no epitran hye).

name: Karakalpak
notes: Karakalpak (qaraqalpaq tili), KIPCHAK Turkic (close to Kazakh), ~600k (Karakalpakstan, NW Uzbekistan), the 2016 LATIN alphabet (highly phonemic). A greedy digraph+letter scan (src/languages/karakalpak/). THE ORTHOGRAPHY WRITES the uvular/velar choice (no harmony inference, unlike Kazakh): uvular q→[q] / x→[χ] / ǵ→[ʁ] vs velar k g / h; the acute FRONT vowels á ó ú→[æ ø y] vs back a o u→[ɑ o u]; the DOTLESS ı→[ɯ] vs dotted i→[i]; ń→[ŋ], j→[ʒ], w→[w], y→[j], digraphs sh→[ʃ] ch→[t͡ʃ]; final stress. ★ Turkish-I casing handled (dotless capital I→[ɯ]→ı, not JS's dotted i — Ishan→ɯˈʃɑn). 100% FOLDED / 100% symbol but on a TINY 12-word referee (English Wiktionary 'Karakalpak terms with IPA pronunciation' — ONLY source; no wikipron/kaikki/epitran) → the % confirms the mappings, not broad accuracy. Verified on goldens (qaraqalpaq→qɑrɑqɑlˈpɑq, ǵárezsizlik→ʁærezsizˈlik). 🔷 THIN single-source. Deferred: numbers, larger referee, Cyrillic front-end.

name: Kabyle
notes: Northern Berber (Zenati), Algeria (~5M). The BEST-DOCUMENTED / most-resourced Berber variety, phonemic Berber Latin orthography → the most tractable Amazigh entry point. Under 10M alone, but the whole Berber/Amazigh branch (Afroasiatic, ~30M+) is otherwise absent.

name: Kamba
notes: Bantu (Kenya): greedy grapheme g2p, ⟨v⟩=β, ⟨sy⟩=ʃ, ⟨ky⟩=t͡ʃ, ⟨nth⟩=ⁿð, tilde=vowel-quality (ĩ=e/ũ=o). Thin 5-word referee (single-source).

name: Kabuverdianu
notes: Portuguese-lexified creole (Santiago variety), ALUPEC phonemic orthography: greedy g2p (digraphs dj/tx/nh/lh) + Portuguese-creole nasalization + accent/penult stress. AUTHORED — no machine referee (wikipron none, kaikki 7 IPA words); anchored on the 7 kaikki words (test gold). FIRST bespoke creole engine.

name: Kikuyu (Gikuyu)
notes: Largest language of Kenya. Pure greedy g2p from the Latin orthography (no code rules — fricativization + prenasalization in the table). 99.4% folded vs en.wiktionary Kikuyu (1062w — LARGE human referee, the fleet's highest folded score), single-source. Signatures: 7-vowel ATR (TILDE=quality not nasal: ⟨ĩ⟩=e, ⟨ũ⟩=o, ⟨e⟩=ɛ, ⟨o⟩=ɔ), fricativization ⟨b⟩=β/⟨th⟩=ð/⟨g⟩=ɣ/⟨c⟩=ɕ, prenasal ⟨mb nd nj ng⟩, ⟨ng'⟩=ŋ, ⟨ny⟩=ɲ, ⟨r⟩=ɾ. Dahl's Law orthographic (no rule). Tone (H/L+downstep) unwritten→not emitted. Numbers deferred. Referee built by tools/corpus/build-referee.ts (batched). Englebretson sketch grammar + Wahome & Subiyanto (2023) corroborate (both phoneme tables confirm ⟨ĩ⟩=e/⟨ũ⟩=o).

name: Kalaallisut (Greenlandic)
notes: Kalaallisut / West Greenlandic (kalaallisut), Eskimo-Aleut (Inuit branch), ~56k (Greenland), the 1973 PHONEMIC Latin orthography — THE FLEET'S FIRST ESKIMO-ALEUT language (a new family). A near-1:1 scan (the orthography is highly phonemic, Finnish/Māori-tier). ★ THREE-VOWEL system /a i u/ (the Inuit hallmark); ⟨e o⟩ are NOT phonemes — they are the LOWERED allophones of /i u/ written before a uvular ⟨q r⟩, so ⟨e⟩→[i], ⟨o⟩→[u] (aaneq→aːniq, nanoq→nanuq). ★ the UVULAR stop ⟨q⟩→[q] + uvular fricative ⟨r⟩→[ʁ]; ⟨ng⟩→[ŋ], ⟨nng⟩→[ŋː]; a doubled letter → LENGTH (illu→ilːu); loan ⟨b d⟩→[p t] (no voiced stops). No stress. 94.8% FOLDED / 98.5% symbol vs wikipron kal_latn_broad (HUMAN, 1581) — a clean high-scoring bring-up (transparent orthography + single-dialect referee = a tight measurement, unlike the multi-dialect Celtic ones). Folds: the length NOTATION (doubled segment → single, matching the backbone-stripped output), ʁ~r. The ~6% residual is the DEFERRED NARROW phonetic layer (uvular vowel-lowering o→[ɔ], regressive assimilation anarnaq→[anɑnnɑq], ll→[ɬ]). 🔷 single-source family (wikipron; kaikki Greenlandic same source) but transparent orthography. Deferred: the phonetic assimilation/uvular-lowering narrow layer, numbers.

name: Kyrgyz
notes: Turkic (Kipchak), Cyrillic, sibling of Kazakh. Cleanroom RULE g2p (src/languages/kyrgyz/, mirrors the kk Cyrillic-scan shape); vowel harmony is SPELLED. KEY: VELAR/UVULAR HARMONY that Kyrgyz does NOT spell (unlike kk қ/ғ) — к->q/г->ʁ next to a back vowel (а о у ы), k/ɡ front; a CODA is governed by the preceding vowel (ак->aq), an onset by the following (Баткен->batken). Plus dark-l harmony (л->ɫ/l), LONG vowels (тоо->toː), ж->d͡ʒ, ң->ŋ, intervocalic б->β (обон->oβon). Turkic-decimal numbers (space-separated). 90.7% FOLDED vs wikipron kir_cyrl_broad (HUMAN, 888; real-word 91.9%); referee is SMALL + proper-noun-heavy. Folds = one-phoneme allophony (ɫ~l, ɑ~a, r~ɾ, front-velar c~k/ɟ~ɡ). Residual = letter-name entries + foreign names.

name: Latin
notes: CLASSICAL Latin (the reconstructed pronunciation, Allen Vox Latina), Italic (Indo-European), Latin script with MACRONS — Italic. Classical Latin g2p is near-fully deterministic from macronized spelling: short vowels LAX ⟨e i o u⟩→[ɛ ɪ ɔ ʊ] while macrons give length ([aː eː …]); a short vowel in HIATUS is TENSE (alia→alia). ⟨c⟩ ALWAYS [k] (Caesar→kae̯sar), ⟨v⟩→[w] (vīta→wiːta), ⟨qu⟩→[kʷ], ⟨ngu⟩+V→[ŋ ɡʷ], ⟨x⟩→[k s], ⟨gn⟩→[ŋ n] (initial→[n]), aspirates ⟨ph th ch⟩→[pʰ tʰ kʰ]; word-initial/intervocalic ⟨i j⟩→glide [j] (geminate [j j] after a short vowel eius→ɛjjʊs, single after a long one); DARK ⟨l⟩→[ɫ]; ⟨b⟩→[p] before ⟨s t⟩; intervocalic ⟨z⟩→[z z]; ⟨n⟩→[ŋ] before a velar; the signature WORD-FINAL ⟨-Vm⟩→ nasalized LONG vowel [Ṽː] (bellum→bɛllũː, aquam→akʷãː). Penult/antepenult WEIGHT stress emitted. 92.1% FOLDED / 98.9% symbol vs wikipron lat_latn_clas_narrow (44,907 human). Folds: intervocalic ⟨h⟩ ɦ~h (referee also drops it), diphthong offglide U+032F. Residual = referee QUANTITY inconsistency (Casīna macron-but-short; ū̆/ī̆ common-quantity attested both ways) + ⟨h⟩-drop + rare Greek/Hebrew loans + in-/con- assimilation. 🔷 human single-source-FAMILY (wikipron; kaikki = same Wiktionary source, espeak la_rules = authored impl of the same Allen reconstruction; no epitran lat). Ecclesiastical deferred (a future tradition param).

name: Luxembourgish
notes: West Germanic (Moselle Franconian) — Lëtzebuergesch (~390k), Latin, German-derived orthography + French loans. Greedy longest-match grapheme scan + German-style code rules. The DIPHTHONG system ⟨ei/ai⟩→ai̯ ⟨au⟩→æu̯ ⟨ou⟩→əu̯ ⟨éi⟩→ei̯ (⟨é⟩ alone→eː) ⟨ie⟩→iə ⟨ue⟩→uə; ⟨w⟩→v ⟨v⟩→f ⟨z⟩→t͡s ⟨ch⟩→χ ⟨sch⟩→ʃ ⟨qu⟩→kv; initial st/sp→ʃt/ʃp, onset s→z but ss→s; short stressed ⟨e⟩→æ / reduced→ə (Belsch→bælʃ; stress≈first vowel past a ge/be/ver/er prefix); geminate collapse; regressive devoicing + final g→χ/vowel, k/consonant (Dag→daːχ vs Alg→alk). 72.1% FOLDED / 93.0% symbol vs wikipron ltz_latn_broad (3893 human). Vowel LENGTH folded (open/closed-syllable-conditioned, deferred). Residual = French-loan lexicon tail + Romance penult stress + referee notation. 🔷 single-source-family (broad+narrow = same Wiktionary scrape). Deferred: weight-based stress+length, French lexicon, numbers, Eifeler-Regel n-sandhi.

name: Lithuanian
notes: Baltic: rule g2p with palatalization (Cʲ before front V, left-spread except velars) + softening-i drop + regressive voicing + ⟨a⟩-fronting. wikipron lit_latn_narrow (15513) 86.6% folded / 98.7% symbol.

name: Latgalian
notes: Latgalian (latgaļu volūda), EASTERN BALTIC, a close sibling of Latvian, ~150k (Latgale, E. Latvia), Latin — Eastern Baltic. Self-contained scan (src/languages/latgalian/) → onset palatalization → voicing assimilation. ★★ SIGNATURE = the ⟨i⟩/⟨y⟩ SOFT/HARD split: front ⟨i ī e ē⟩ PALATALIZE the preceding consonant(s) (ci→t͡sʲi, bet→bʲæt, acis→at͡sʲis), but ⟨y⟩→[ɨ] is a HARD central vowel (Latvian lacks it) that does NOT (cylvāks→t͡sɨlvaːks). Vowels a e i o u y→a æ i ɔ u ɨ, macron=LONG; c č š ž→t͡s t͡ʃ ʃ ʒ, dz dž tz→d͡z d͡ʒ d͡z, written palatals ļ ņ ģ ķ ř→lʲ nʲ ɡʲ kʲ rʲ, v→w coda; Baltic voicing assimilation (Latgola→ladɡɔla). Pitch ACCENT unwritten→folded. 77.7% FOLDED / 93.3% symbol vs wikipron ltg_latn_narrow (HUMAN, 488) + 76.0%/93.1% symbol vs kaikki (516). ★ high SYMBOL (93%) is the truer signal; folded dragged by narrow-referee detail + lexically-inconsistent coda palatalization (onset-only after a blanket coda rule tested -13pp). 🔷 single-source-family. Deferred: coda/lexical palatalization, pitch accent, numbers.

name: Luo (Dholuo)
notes: Western Nilotic (Luo group), Latin, ~4-5M around Lake Victoria. FIRST Nilotic language. Greedy g2p (src/languages/luo/) + ONE code rule (high-vowel glide i/u+V->j/w). Signatures: DENTAL vs ALVEOLAR contrast (th/dh->theta/eth vs t/d), PRENASALIZED voiced stops (mb->mb-super, nd->nd-super, nj->nd3-super, ng->Ng), ng'->N vs ng->Ng, ny->J, palatals ch->tS/j->d3, r->4. The 9-vowel +-ATR distinction and register TONE (H/L) are UNWRITTEN -> emitted at a +ATR/toneless default (folded). 100% folded (17/17) vs the ONLY referee = 17-word en.wiktionary Luo IPA (no kaikki/epitran/wikipron); consonants corroborated by Tucker (1994). Single-source. ATR harmony + tone + numbers deferred.

name: Luyia (Luhya)
notes: Luhya macrolanguage — a cluster of ~20 varieties, W Kenya (~7M combined). No single standard variety. Latin.

name: Latvian
notes: Baltic, sibling of Lithuanian but SEPARATE engine: written palatals (ģ ķ ļ ņ→ɟ c ʎ ɲ) + length (macrons→ː) + fixed first-syllable stress; native ⟨o⟩→[uɔ̯], regressive devoicing. wikipron lav_latn_narrow 83.7% folded / 96.5% symbol.

name: Magahi
notes: BESPOKE (was mag→bho alias). Bhojpuri engine + phonology (shared Bihari: no length, श/ष→s, ण/ञ→n) + DOCUMENTED Magahi glide hardening (Vinod Kumar 2026 comparative study §6.2): word-initial व→b (वंश→bans), य→d͡ʒ (यन्त्र→jantar), where Bhojpuri preserves glides. No machine referee. 🔷 single-source delta on grammar-anchored base.

name: Maori
notes: Eastern Polynesian, New Zealand (~185k), Latin — one of the SIMPLEST orthographies in the fleet (near-1:1 phonemic). Direct grapheme g2p: 5 vowels + MACRON=LENGTH (ā ē ī ō ū→aː eː iː oː uː), ⟨p t k m n h w⟩, ⟨r⟩→[ɾ] tap, digraphs ⟨wh⟩→[ɸ] (whenua→ɸenua) + ⟨ng⟩→[ŋ] (tangata→taŋata). Strict CV — no codas/clusters/glides (Aotearoa→aoteaɾoa). Stress (mora-based, unwritten) not emitted. 99.8% FOLDED / 100.0% symbol on the FIRST pass vs wikipron mri_latn_broad (1005 human; the only 2 misses = the non-Māori glyph Ḵ). Folds: rhotic r~ɾ, ⟨wh⟩ ɸ~f. 🔷 single-source-family (broad+narrow same Wiktionary scrape) but near-ceiling. Deferred: mora-stress model, numbers.

name: Minangkabau
notes: West Sumatra (~5.5M). Malayic, close to Indonesian/Malay. Latin. Just under 10M.

name: Macedonian
notes: South Slavic, Cyrillic, fully phonemic + no vowel reduction: grapheme scan + shared phonotactics (dark-l, syllabic-r, final devoicing, n→ŋ) + distinct palatal letters (ѓ ќ љ њ ѕ џ ј) + FIXED antepenult stress. wikipron mkd_cyrl_narrow 99.0% folded / 99.8% symbol (63024 headwords, near-ceiling).

name: Mongolian (Khalkha)
notes: Standard Khalkha, Cyrillic. Greedy g2p + the DEEP-orthography rules (non-initial short-vowel reduction to one reduced-vowel phoneme / word-final deletion + epenthesis; хурга->xurəɢ), aspirated-vs-unaspirated stop system (б=p т=tʰ), л->ɮ, back-harmony г->ɢ/х->χ, final н->ŋ, final в->f devoicing, doubled->long, iotated е/ё/я/ю, palatalizing ь. 52.5% FOLDED vs en.wiktionary Mongolian (1342 Cyrillic words, NARROW/phonetic) — single-source; the % understates quality (narrow referee + loanword full-vowel tail needing a lexicon), native common-word output is sound. + cardinal numbers + a mixed-harmony loanword heuristic + a Mongol-bichig (traditional-script) front-end (transliterate->Cyrillic, 33% on 118 words).

name: Mossi (Mooré)
notes: Niger-Congo Gur (Oti-Volta). Wolof-shaped greedy g2p + gemination + nasal assimilation from the Latin (Burkinabé) orthography. DUAL-GROUNDED: 94.9% folded vs en.wiktionary Moore (39w, single numeric referee, loanword-heavy) + the FSI Moré Basic Course (Lehr/Redden/Balima 1966) phonology (corroborates ⟨r⟩=flap-of-/d/, ⟨o⟩=/o/ no ⟨ɔ⟩, ⟨ny⟩=ɲ, /n/=[n,ŋ], H/L tone). Signatures: ATR letters ⟨ɛ ɩ ʋ⟩, doubling=length, tilde=nasal, ⟨r⟩=ɾ, ⟨y⟩=j, geminate Cː, ⟨n⟩→ŋ before g/k. Tone (2-tone H/L) unwritten→not emitted. Numbers deferred.

name: Maltese
notes: The ONLY Semitic language in the LATIN alphabet (Malti; Siculo-Arabic core + Sicilian/Italian/English). Fairly phonemic → greedy grapheme scan + the silent-letter rules + assimilation. Signatures: ⟨q⟩→ʔ, ⟨ċ⟩→t͡ʃ, ⟨ġ⟩→d͡ʒ, ⟨ħ⟩→ħ, ⟨x⟩→ʃ, ⟨z⟩→t͡s vs ⟨ż⟩→z; ⟨għ⟩ silent (colours the vowel)/[ħ] final, ⟨h⟩ silent medial/[ħ] final, ⟨ie⟩→ɪ; final devoicing + regressive voicing assimilation + affricate gemination (⟨ġġ⟩→dd͡ʒ) + n→m before a labial. 93.0% FOLDED / 98.2% symbol vs wikipron mlt_latn_broad (15,837 human). Vowel LENGTH folded (stress-conditioned Arabic-style weight, deferred). 🔷 single-source but LARGE. Deferred: weight-based stress + length, numbers, ⟨għ⟩-as-glide.

name: Totontepec Mixe
notes: Totontepec Mixe (ayöök), Mixe-Zoquean (Mixean, Oaxaca, North Highland), ~6k (Oaxaca) — THE FLEET'S FIRST MIXE-ZOQUEAN language (a new family). AUTHORED from Crawford, *Totontepec Mixe Phonotagmemics* (SIL 1963) — a published phonology (the bho grammar-mined mold). ★ 9 VOWELS (Crawford): a e i o u→[a e i o u], ä→[æ], ë→[ɨ], ü→[ʌ], ö→[ʊ]; doubled vowel → LENGTH. Consonants ⟨ts⟩→[t͡s], ⟨tx cy⟩→[t͡ʃ], ⟨x⟩→[ʃ], ⟨j⟩→[h], ⟨c⟩→[k], ⟨ꞌ '⟩→[ʔ]. ★★ THE CRAWFORD ALLOPHONY (reproduces his own transcriptions exactly): POST-NASAL VOICING /p t ts k/→[b d d͡z ɡ] (mpahk→mbahk his example, cumantoc→kumandok); intervocalic ⟨d g⟩→[ð ɣ] (tocunaguc→tokunaɣuk); ⟨n⟩→[ŋ] before a velar (tsingavus→t͡siŋɡavus his example); ⟨ny⟩→[ɲ]. SEVERELY REFEREE-LIMITED (not a quality %): no wikipron/kaikki/Wiktionary-IPA; the only independent data is the ASJP North-Highland-Mixe Swadesh list, 3 concepts overlapping the Wiktionary lemmas (dog/I/tree) → 3/3 under coarseness folds = an inventory check on 3 words. The real gate is Crawford + the goldens. 🔷 authored-from-published-grammar, referee-limited. Deferred: the modern UNDERLINE diacritic (a̱ o̱ u̱, absent from Crawford, treated as plain — the disclosed residual), /v/→[f] terminus + creaky-glottal detail, stress, numbers.

name: Neapolitan
notes: Neapolitan-Calabrian (Southern Italian), S Italy (~5M; up to ~30M for the wider Southern-Italian group). CONTESTED: an Italian dialect continuum with no single standard; ~10M+ only if the group is aggregated.

name: Nama (Khoekhoe)
notes: Nama (Khoekhoe / Damara / Khoekhoegowab), KHOE-KWADI, Latin (with the Unicode click letters), ~250k (Namibia/South Africa) — A CLICK language. A click-aware scan (src/languages/nama/). ★★ HALLMARK = the CLICK system: 4 PLACES ǀ dental / ǁ lateral / ǂ palatal / ǃ alveolar × 5 ACCOMPANIMENTS — bare ǀ→[ᵑ̊ǀˀ] (glottalised nasal), ǀg→[ᵏǀ] (tenuis), ǀkh→[ᵏǀʰ] (aspirated), ǀh→[ᵑ̊ǀʰ] (aspirated nasal), ǀn→[ᵑǀ] (voiced nasal). Non-click: kh→[kʰ], g (not after a click)→[x], w→[w], final gender -b→[p] (ǀgomab→ǀomap), macron ā→long [aː]. Lexical TONE (H/L) unwritten → folded. 82.6% FOLDED / 94.4% symbol (38/46) on English Wiktionary 'Khoekhoe terms with IPA pronunciation'. 🔷 THIN + largely REFERENCE-PARITY (cdo/bo situation): the 46 entries are dominated by the click-letter DEFINITIONS (the orthography→IPA spec we implement) + ~7 real words as the independent check; word residuals = the referee's inconsistent onset-simplification (OUR full standard forms are more precise). No wikipron/kaikki/epitran. Deferred: tone, numbers, larger referee.

name: Norwegian Bokmål
notes: North Germanic, Latin, Urban East Norwegian. TWO-TIER: an NST pronunciation lexicon (National Library of Norway, CC0, INDEPENDENT of the Wiktionary referee; ~38k common forms, ~98% of real-text tokens, carrying lexical stress + vowel quality) -> a cleanroom RULE g2p fallback (phonemizeWordRules; COMPLEMENTARY VOWEL LENGTH picks quality ⟨o⟩->uː/ɔ, ⟨u⟩->ʉː/ʉ, ⟨å⟩->oː/ɔ; front-vowel softening sk/k/g->ʃ/ç/j; digraphs sj/skj->ʃ, kj/tj->ç, hv->ʋ; retroflex r+coronal->ʈ/ɳ/ɭ/ʂ barn->bɑːɳ; silent final ⟨d⟩ god->ɡuː; unstressed ⟨e⟩->ə). Western-composer numbers. Referee kaikki/wikipron is dictionary-shaped so the raw uniform % is deflated; the honest signal = the FREQUENCY-WEIGHTED metric (freq/nb.txt, OpenSubtitles, wired into referee-eval): 90.7% shipped (lexicon->rules) vs 63.4% rules-only, and NST corroborates the rule engine independently (breaks single-source). OOV tier (async phonemizeNbNeural): a stress-predicting BiLSTM tagger (ONNX, structuralTagger contract, trained on the full 631k NST with the stress mark in the tag alphabet -> predicts stress POSITION + vowel quality from spelling), held-out far above the perceptron prototype (56.6%); onnxruntime-node optional, falls back to sync. Folds: pitch accent (unwritten->deferred), rhotic ɾ~ʁ, low-vowel ɑ~a. 🟢 bounded: vowel/stress closed by lexicon+tagger, irreducible remainder = pitch accent (not orthographically encoded).

name: Classical Nahuatl
pr: Classical Nahuatl (nāhuatlahtōlli), Uto-Aztecan, the language of the Aztec Empire (16th-c. Central Mexico) — THE FLEET'S FIRST UTO-AZTECAN language (a new family). The traditional Spanish-based Latin orthography. AUTHORED from Andrews, *Introduction to Classical Nahuatl* (§2). A POSITION-AWARE scan of the Spanish-orthography context rules (§2.4): ⟨c⟩→[s] before e/i else [k], ⟨qu⟩→[k], ⟨z⟩→[s], ⟨cu⟩+V / V⟨uc⟩→[kʷ], ⟨hu⟩+V / V⟨uh⟩→[w], saltillo ⟨h⟩→[ʔ] (post-vowel only), ⟨x⟩→ʃ, ⟨tz tl ch⟩→[t͡s t͡ɬ t͡ʃ], the ⟨chu⟩=[kw] trap (cachuah=/kakwa/). 8 vowels /a e i o/ × length — LENGTH is UNWRITTEN in traditional texts → short vowels (backbone strips referee ː). WELL-RESOURCED, TWO corroborating HUMAN referees: wikipron nci_latn_broad (886) 93.1% folded / 98.8% symbol + kaikki (2329) 92.1% / 98.3%. Residuals are all 1× singletons (Spanish proper-noun loans, unwritten lexical saltillo, optional vowel raising) — no systematic bug. 🔷 well-resourced, doubly-corroborated. Deferred: penultimate stress, unwritten vowel length + lexical saltillo (need a lexicon), l→ɬ/n→ŋ/coda-w allophony, numbers.

name: Nogai
notes: Nogai (ногай тили / ногайша), KIPCHAK Turkic (Kipchak-Nogai / South-Kipchak, close to Kazakh/Karakalpak), ~90k (North Caucasus: Dagestan/Stavropol/Karachay-Cherkessia + Turkey), CYRILLIC. Completes the espeak-flagged Kipchak set (Bashkir/Kazakh/Kyrgyz/Tatar/Karakalpak/Crimean Tatar + Nogai). A near-deterministic Cyrillic grapheme scan: the orthography WRITES the uvulars/velar-nasal as DIGRAPHS (hard-sign ъ) ⟨къ⟩→[q], ⟨гъ⟩→[ʁ], ⟨нъ⟩→[ŋ] — so ⟨к г⟩ are ALWAYS [k ɡ], no harmony inference (the Bashkir pattern). Front vowels are DIGRAPHS (soft-sign ь) ⟨аь⟩→[æ], ⟨оь⟩→[ø], ⟨уь⟩→[y]; ⟨ы⟩→[ɯ]; iotated ⟨я ю ё⟩ + initial/post-vocalic ⟨е⟩→[je]; ⟨ж⟩→[ʒ], ⟨ш⟩→[ʃ], ⟨ч⟩→[t͡ʃ], ⟨х⟩→[x]; ⟨в⟩→[w] post-vocalic coda (сув→suw) / [v] onset; word-final stress. SEVERELY REFEREE-LIMITED (the st/umb/bal mold) — no wikipron/epitran nog; kaikki has ONE IPA (туькен→/ty.ken/==our tyˈken, in the golden). The only independent corpus is the ASJP Nogai Swadesh list (Lexibank CC0, coarse, orthography-free, ~24 pairs) → 100% folded / 100% symbol, but ASJP cannot encode [y ø ɯ] or coda /w/ (real distinctions our g2p keeps, the goldens assert) so those fold → an INVENTORY corroboration, not an orthographic-accuracy signal. Verified on goldens (къыз→qɯz, гъарув→ʁaruw, коьз→køz, муьйиз→myjiz, янъы→jaŋɯ). 🔷 authored, referee-limited. Deferred: numbers, an orthographic-IPA referee (none exists), intervocalic native ⟨в⟩→[w] (бавыр→bawɯr; coda-only rule emits [v] — lexical split with loan [v], the crh deferral).

name: Sepedi (Northern Sotho)
notes: Authored ⛔ cannot-verify — NO referee at all. Shared Sotho-Tswana engine; š→ʃ, kg→kx, hl→ɬ, ejective p/t/k (unverified for Sepedi). Tone deferred.

name: Occitan
notes: Occitano-Romance (Gallo-Romance), southern France (~200k). Added for FLEURS coverage. The classical orthography is PAN-DIALECTAL (one spelling → dialect-specific readings) → targets LANGUEDOCIEN (the koine + most-likely FLEURS reader dialect; FLEURS audio dialect unverified). Greedy Gallo-Romance scan: unstressed ⟨o⟩→[u], final ⟨a⟩→[ɔ], ⟨u⟩→[y]/[w], ⟨ò⟩→ɔ; ⟨c g⟩ softening, ⟨lh⟩→ʎ ⟨nh⟩→ɲ ⟨ch⟩→t͡ʃ ⟨j⟩→d͡ʒ ⟨v⟩→b; intervocalic ⟨s⟩→z; ⟨i⟩→[j] before vowel; final devoicing; LANGUEDOCIEN final-consonant deletion (word-final ⟨n r⟩ after vowel drops: Japon→dʒapu, cantar→kanta; final-r +11pp). 70.4% FOLDED / 93.3% symbol vs wikipron oci_latn_broad (675 human, dialect-mixed — noisy proxy). Folds: rhotic ʁ~ɾ, spirantization β/ð/ɣ→b/d/ɡ, ch t͡s~t͡ʃ, final-a spread, stress. kaikki (1136) is Béarn/Niçard-tagged → unusable as Languedocien gold. 🔷 thin + dialect-mixed. Deferred: dialect overrides (Gascon/Provençal/Niçard) as a `dialect` param — NOT attempted (no clean per-dialect data), stress, numbers.

name: Papiamento
notes: Papiamentu (Papiamento), an IBERIAN- (Portuguese/Spanish-) lexified CREOLE of the ABC islands (Aruba/Bonaire/Curaçao), ~340k — A creole. The Curaçao PHONEMIC orthography, a greedy scan (src/languages/papiamento/). ★ HALLMARK = coda-⟨n⟩ RETENTION (Maurer; Kouwenberg & Murray): Papiamentu KEEPS a coda ⟨n⟩ — WORD-FINAL ⟨n⟩→[ŋ] (+ vowel nasalization: bon→bõŋ, federashon→fedeɾaˈʃõŋ), medial ⟨n⟩ stays [n] (kontra→kontɾa, Papiamentu→papiaˈmentu). The referee's Portuguese-style dropped-⟨n⟩ (ʃõ) is folded. Digraphs ch/sh/dj/zj→t͡ʃ ʃ d͡ʒ ʒ; open vowels è ò ù→ɛ ɔ ø; ñ→ɲ y→j r→ɾ; degemination (Willemstad→wilemstad); open vowels è ò ù→ɛ ɔ ø + ⟨ou⟩ diphthong→ɔu; acute/penult stress. Lexical PITCH-ACCENT (H/L) not written → folded. 70% FOLDED / 93.1% symbol (14/20) on kaikki + Wiktionary (~20 pairs; no wikipron/epitran). % DEPRESSED by the referee's divergent transcription (dropped coda-n, unmarked ⟨o⟩→ɔ) — output canonically correct. Residual = coda-r→h (deporte), referee's medial coda-n DROP (canonical keeps it), v→f (-ivo). 🔷 THIN single-source-family. Deferred: numbers, larger referee, vowel-reduction/coda-r/pitch-accent lexica.

name: Portuguese (Brazilian)
notes: Accent variant of pt: the EP engine in dialect:"bp" mode (position-split reduction, coda-l→w, t/d→t͡ʃ/d͡ʒ before i). Labels the FLEURS pt_br audio.

name: Quechua
notes: Southern Quechua (Cusco-Collao + Ayacucho), Latin, ~7-8M — Quechuan. Standardised trilingual orthography: 3-vowel system ⟨a i u⟩ + a THREE-WAY stop series written OVERTLY — plain ⟨p t k q ch⟩, aspirated with ⟨h⟩ (⟨ph th kh qh chh⟩→pʰ tʰ kʰ qʰ t͡ʃʰ), ejective with ⟨'⟩ (⟨p' t' k' q' ch'⟩→pʼ tʼ kʼ qʼ t͡ʃʼ); uvular ⟨q⟩→[q], ⟨ll⟩→ʎ ⟨ñ⟩→ɲ ⟨r⟩→[ɾ] tap ⟨sh⟩→ʃ. Longest-match scan + regular PENULTIMATE stress. 93.0% FOLDED / 97.6% symbol vs kaikki Quechua (171 human, English Wiktionary); 88.3% skeleton agreement with epitran quy-Latn (independent 2nd). Uvular vowel-lowering (/i u/→[e o] near q) NOT emitted — the two referees CONFLICT (epitran lowers, kaikki normalises to phonemic /i u/), so we keep the 3-vowel norm. 🔷 primary human + independent epitran 2nd.

name: K'iche'
notes: K'iche' (Qatzijob'al), the largest MAYAN language (~1.1M, Guatemala), Latin (ALMG orthography) — Mayan. Near-1:1 phonemic longest-match scan. HALLMARK = the EJECTIVE/glottalized series b'→ɓ (implosive), t'→tʼ, k'→kʼ, q'→qʼ (uvular), tz'→t͡sʼ, ch'→t͡ʃʼ — CONTRASTING with the ASPIRATED plain stops p/t/k/q/tz/ch→pʰ tʰ kʰ qʰ t͡sʰ t͡ʃʰ (allophonic). x→ʃ, j→x, w→ʋ, r→ɻ, '→ʔ, ä→a; vowel LENGTH phonemic but UNWRITTEN in ALMG (folded); final stress. 89.8% FOLDED / 96.0% symbol vs English Wiktionary (127 K'iche' IPA entries, pulled via the MediaWiki API — kaikki has no K'iche'). Folds: unwritten length ː, aspiration ʰ (inconsistent in referee), q'~ʛ. Residual = Wiktionary artifacts (mismatched rows, (d)/(oq) optional notation) + the inconsistent initial glottal onset. 🔷 single-source (no wikipron/kaikki/epitran quc; espeak's quc is authored). Deferred: numbers, the lexical initial-glottal + vowel-length.

name: Rajasthani
notes: Cover term (Marwari, Dhundhari, …), not a single phonology.

name: Rangpuri (KRNB)
notes: Eastern Indo-Aryan, the KRNB lect of Rangpur (Bangladesh)+adjacent India (~15M for the continuum, census-contested), Devanagari. First of the KRNB continuum; Kamta/Rajbanshi/Northern Deshi Bangla follow as dialect deltas (referees staged in tools/krnb/). No machine referee (wikipron/kaikki/epitran all empty) → Toulmin (2006) Appendix A comparative reconstruction, Rangpur point (~370 Devanagari→IPA, ANU open-access, non-circular). Reuses the Hindi abugida engine + a KRNB manifest. Deltas: deaffrication च/छ→s ज→d͡z झ→d͡zʱ; VOICED aspirates retained घझढधभ→ɡʱ d͡zʱ ɖʱ d̪ʱ bʱ; voiceless aspirates positional (ख ठ थ फ keep ʰ initially, deaspirate else); inherent [ɔ], no vowel length, व→w, ण→n, श/ष→ʃ, ◌ॉ→æ. 63.8% FOLDED / 86.8% symbol (folded is a mix of 2-column-PDF extraction noise + residual fine-grained gaps; symbol acc shows the segmental core is solid). Stress prosodic→folded. 🔷 single-source (scholarly reconstruction). Deferred: other 3 KRNB lects, cleaner referee (bbox extractor), anusvara-[ŋ] support, numbers.

name: Aromanian
notes: Aromanian (armãneashti), EASTERN (Balkan) ROMANCE, a close sibling of Romanian, ~250k (Balkans), Latin (Cunia/DIARO orthography). A self-contained Cunia scan (src/languages/aromanian/) borrowing the Romance c/g-softening + diphthong + glide pattern. ★ AROMANIAN DIGRAPHS (where Romanian uses ș ț): ts→[t͡s], dz→[d͡z], sh→[ʃ], nj→[ɲ], lj/ll→[ʎ], dh→[ð], th→[θ] (Greek-contact interdentals), gh→[ɣ], ch→[k]. ã = single central-vowel letter → [ə] (also [ɨ], folded). Romance c/g softening (Crãciun→krət͡ʃun), rising diphthongs ea→[e̯a]/oa→[o̯a] (noaptea→no̯apte̯a), i/u glides; final -u (Latin short -us) DESYLLABIFIES after a single consonant → dropped (cãntãtoru→kəntətor), stays after a cluster (amintu). 97.0% FOLDED / 98.6% symbol vs wikipron rup_latn_narrow (HUMAN, 196) + 95.5% vs kaikki (201) — two corroborating referees. 🔷 single-source-family (both Wiktionary; no epitran). Deferred: stress (unwritten, lexical), numbers.

name: Santali
notes: Santali (ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ), Munda (Austroasiatic), ~7M (India/Bangladesh/Nepal), the OL CHIKI alphabet (U+1C50–1C7F, a distinct script created 1925 by Raghunath Murmu, India 8th Schedule) — Munda, in the Ol Chiki script. Near-phonemic grapheme scan + sign rules: 6 vowels; palatal ⟨ᱪ ᱡ⟩→c/ɟ; retroflex ⟨ᱴ ᱰ ᱬ ᱲ⟩→ʈ ɖ ɳ ɽ; ⟨ᱜ⟩ ɡ vs ⟨ᱠ⟩ k. ⟨ᱷ⟩ aspirates (ᱵᱷ→bʱ); ⟨ᱹ⟩ vowel-mod (ᱟᱹ→ə); ⟨ᱸ⟩ nasal (ᱟᱸ→ã), ⟨ᱺ⟩ lower+nasal. HALLMARK: word-final voiced stop CHECKED/glottalized (ᱫᱟᱜ→dakʼ water, ᱢᱮᱫ→metʼ eye). 92.9% FOLDED / 97.1% symbol vs kaikki Santali (490 HUMAN Ol Chiki). Folds: phrase undertie/dots, ʱ~ʰ, ɟ~d͡ʒ, checked-glottal notation ([kʼ]~[k̚ʔ]~[kˈ] inconsistent → compare final-devoicing). Residual = loans (keep final voiced stop) + citations. 🔷 single-source (kaikki only; no wikipron/epitran sat). Deferred: numbers, loan lexicon.

name: Tashelhit (Shilha)
notes: Tashelhit / Shilha (Taclḥit) — Berber (Amazigh), SW Morocco (~7-9M). NEW family. Consumes the Berber LATIN alphabet + Neo-Tifinagh (ⵜⵉⴼⵉⵏⴰⵖ, official IRCAM script; auto-detected, identical IPA) (near-1:1 phonemic): greedy grapheme scan + labialisation (C+ʷ→Cʷ) + gemination (doubling→Cː). Emphatics ḍ→dˤ etc., pharyngeals ḥ→ħ ɛ→ʕ, uvulars ɣ x→χ q, c→ʃ. 97.4% folded / 99.4% symbol vs wikipron shi_latn + 97.8%/99.5% vs kaikki — but both Wiktionary → 🔷 single-source-family (correlated). Arabic (manuscript, defective abjad) deferred.

name: Shan
notes: Shan / Tai Long (လိၵ်ႈတႆး), Southwestern Tai (Tai-Kadai), Myanmar's Shan State (~3.3M), the SHAN ABUGIDA (a Myanmar-script variant, U+1075–U+108F), TONAL — Shan — joins Thai/Lao/Zhuang in Tai-Kadai. A per-syllable scan (the Burmese abugida template): onset → medials (ွ/ႂ→w, ျ palatalises) → rime (vowel signs × coda) → EXPLICIT lexical tone. Shan marks tone with diacritics (100% consistent): unmarked→˨˦, ႇ→˩, ႈ→˧˧˨, visarga→˥, ႉ→˦˨ (glottalised ˦˨ˀ non-finally). Onsets ၵ→k ၶ→kʰ ၸ→t͡ɕ သ→sʰ (aspirated) ဢ→ʔ ႀ→θ … . Rime quirks: ⟨ူ⟩→o closed/uː open, medial ⟨ွ⟩ rounds inherent→ɔ, ⟨ိူ⟩→ɤ ⟨ို⟩→ɯ, ⟨ႂ⟩ coda→ɰ, ⟨ၢ⟩ and ⟨ႃ⟩ BOTH long aː (short a = inherent sign-less); palatal ⟨ၵျ⟩→d͡ʑ. 98.5% FOLDED (segmental; tones+length Chao/ː-stripped) / 99.1% symbol / 90.3% length-sensitive vs wikipron shn_mymr_broad (2607 human). Residual = wikipron sub-lemma artifact (drops a လွင်ႈ/တၢင်း prefix; our full-orthography reading is more faithful). 🔷 human single-source (no epitran/kaikki; espeak shn = authored). Deferred: numbers, phrase tone sandhi.

name: Slovak
notes: West Slavic, sibling of Czech (cs). Cleanroom RULE g2p (src/languages/slovak/, mirrors the cs engine): palatalisation d/t/n/l->ɟ/c/ɲ/ʎ before soft i/í/e (y/ý HARD: milý->miliː), rising diphthongs ia/ie/iu->ɪ̯a/ɪ̯e/ɪ̯u + ô->u̯ɔ, ä->æ, syllabic l̩/r̩ (long ĺ/ŕ), ľ=ʎ h=ɦ ch=x, gemination, regressive voicing + final devoicing ⟨v⟩ devoices to [f] only in ONSET before a voiceless obstruent (vták->ftaːk), stays [v] in coda/final (stav->stav) unlike cs v->f. Cardinal numbers (paucal agreement, like cs). 89.0% FOLDED vs wikipron slk_latn_broad (HUMAN, 15950); common-word 88.0% ≈ proper-noun 91.2%. Palatalisation before ⟨e⟩ is LEXICAL (deti vs ten) — modelled as a rule (referee majority, +12pp) with a loan/exception tail. Deferred: a kaikki/exception lexicon (cs precedent) for the loanword non-palatalisation tail.

name: Slovenian
notes: Own engine (not BCS shared): Slovak-shaped scan + Slovene rules (lj/nj coda-j-drop, syllabic-r, voicing); vowel quality/length/pitch/schwa folded (unwritten). wikipron slv_latn_broad 96.5% folded / 99.4% symbol.

name: Lule Sami
pr: Lule Sami (julevsámegiella), Uralic (Saami branch), ~700-2000 (Norway/Sweden), the 1983 Latin orthography. AUTHORED from Ylikoski, "Lule Saami" (a published reference chapter — the bho/Crawford grammar-mined mold). A TRANSPARENT SEGMENTAL scan. ★ VOWELS /i u e o ɑ/ + diphthongs ⟨ie uo oa⟩: ⟨a⟩→a, ⟨á⟩→ɑː (the one written length contrast), ⟨å⟩→o, ⟨æ/ä⟩→æ. ★★ THE ORTHOGRAPHY TRAP (North-Saami-style): word-initial ⟨b d g⟩ = VOICELESS UNASPIRATED [p t k] (NOT voiced — bena→[penɑ], giella→[kielːɑ]); ⟨p t k⟩ = the marginal ASPIRATED [pʰ tʰ kʰ]. ⟨sj⟩→ʃ, ⟨tj⟩→t͡ʃ, ⟨ts⟩→t͡s, ⟨dtj⟩→d͡ʒ, ⟨nj⟩→ɲ, ⟨lj⟩→ʎ, ⟨ŋ⟩→ŋ; doubled→geminate [Cː]; first-syllable stress. SEVERELY REFEREE-LIMITED (not a quality %): no wikipron, no kaikki-IPA (970 bare forms), no Wiktionary-IPA. The only independent phonetic data is the ASJP LULE_SAAMI Swadesh list (Lexibank, CC0, coarse), joined with kaikki (gloss→orthography) = 43 curated pairs → 62.8% folded / 89.9% symbol (SYMBOL is the honest headline; ASJP is coarse + its LULE_SAAMI_2 doculect applies un-orthographic labial harmony). The engine ASJP-confirms the key mappings (⟨b d g⟩→[p t k], the digraphs, the diphthongs). 🔷 authored-from-published-grammar, referee-limited. Deferred: the COMPLEX MORPHOPHONOLOGY (3-grade consonant gradation, epenthetic vowels, labial harmony, 2nd-syllable lengthening, pervasive UNWRITTEN length), the loan aspirated/voiced-stop + retroflex series, numbers.

name: Albanian
notes: Standard Albanian (Shqip, Tosk-based), Latin (36 letters), ~6M — Indo-European, its OWN branch. Fairly phonemic, rich DIGRAPH system: ⟨dh th sh zh xh⟩→[ð θ ʃ ʒ d͡ʒ], PALATALS ⟨gj⟩→[ɟ] ⟨q⟩→[c], ⟨nj⟩→[ɲ] ⟨ll⟩→[ɫ] ⟨rr⟩→[r] trill vs ⟨r⟩→[ɾ] tap; ⟨c⟩→[t͡s] ⟨ç⟩→[t͡ʃ] ⟨x⟩→[d͡z]; 7 vowels ⟨e⟩→[ɛ] ⟨y⟩→[y] ⟨ë⟩→[ə]. Longest-match scan + penultimate stress. TWO INDEPENDENT sources: kaikki Albanian (HUMAN, 6002) 87.8% folded / 97.3% symbol; epitran sqi-Latn (independent rule-based G2P) 90.2%/98.5%. Residual = variable word-final ⟨ë⟩ (Tosk keeps [ə], some drop+lengthen — lexical) + proper-noun/loan oddities. 🔷 human primary + independent epitran G2P 2nd. Deferred: numbers, ⟨ë⟩-drop dialect variant.

name: Sesotho (Southern Sotho)
notes: Authored beyond-referee (Setswana pattern, Doke & Mofokeng); anchored on the clean kaikki attestation phuputso→pʰupʼut͡sʼɔ (EXACT). EJECTIVE p/t/k→pʼ/tʼ/kʼ, ts→t͡sʼ, hl→ɬ, kg→kχ. NOT aliasable to tn. Vowel height unwritten. 🔷.

name: Turkmen
notes: Standard Turkmen (Türkmençe), Oghuz Turkic, Latin (30 letters, post-1990s), ~5-7M — Near-phonemic direct grapheme scan. THE HALLMARK: INTERDENTAL fricatives ⟨s⟩→[θ] ⟨z⟩→[ð] (shared with Bashkir — söz→θøð). 9 vowels ⟨a⟩→[ɑ] back, ⟨ä⟩→[æ] ⟨ö⟩→[ø] ⟨ü⟩→[y] ⟨y⟩→[ɯ] + UNWRITTEN phonemic length (folded); ⟨ç⟩→t͡ʃ ⟨j⟩→d͡ʒ ⟨ž⟩→ʒ ⟨ş⟩→ʃ ⟨ň⟩→ŋ ⟨ý⟩→j ⟨h⟩→x. Final stress. kaikki (HUMAN, 530) 80.4% folded / 94.9% symbol; wikipron (424) 91.5%/97.9%; epitran tuk-Latn (independent, NAIVE on interdentals → we CORRECT it, Shona pattern) 77.0%/95.1%. 🔷 kaikki human primary + wikipron (correlated) + epitran (independent). Deferred: unwritten length, numbers, g-spirantization.

name: Tsonga
notes: Xitsonga, South Africa / Mozambique (~7M; an official SA language). Latin.

name: Tatar
notes: Standard Tatar (Татар теле), Kipchak Turkic, CYRILLIC (official), ~5M (Tatarstan) — Cyrillic grapheme scan with VOWEL-HARMONY backing: ⟨к⟩→[q]/⟨г⟩→[ʁ] next to a BACK vowel (ак→ɑq) but [k]/[ɡ] next to a FRONT vowel (мәктәп→mæktæp, көз→køz). Special letters ⟨ә⟩→[æ] ⟨ө⟩→[ø] ⟨ү⟩→[y] ⟨ы⟩→[ɨ] ⟨җ⟩→[ʑ] ⟨ң⟩→[ŋ] ⟨һ⟩→[h] ⟨ч⟩→[ɕ]; iotated ⟨я ю ё⟩; ⟨а⟩→[a] in front-harmony words. Final stress. REFEREE-LIMITED: the ONLY referee is a THIN NOISY kaikki set (69 Cyrillic IPA, heavy with Russian/Arabic loan pronunciations; no wikipron tt, no epitran tat). 50.7% folded / 84.3% symbol — but verified CORRECT on the native subset (weekday names, ак, вөҗдан, балык). 🔷 THIN single-source (Bambara/Irish-tier). Deferred: fuller harmony, numbers, an independent referee.

name: Central Atlas Tamazight
notes: Central Morocco (~5M). Tifinagh (official) + Latin.

name: Umbundu
notes: Bantu (R11, Angola). Greedy Latin g2p (Chichewa/Shona pattern, open CV) authored from the Schadeberg (1982) 'Nasalization in UMbundu' (primary R11 phonology): VOICED obstruents ONLY prenasalised (mb/nd/nj/ng->ᵐb/ⁿd/ᶮd͡ʒ/ᵑɡ), c->t͡ʃ (palatal, not [ʃ]), v->v, no native /r/ (r->l), ñ/ny->ɲ, ng'->ŋ, l->l, plain p/t/k + f/s/h. 5 oral + 5 nasal vowels (no length). REFEREE-SCARCE: no wikipron/kaikki/epitran/Wiktionary-IPA; the ASJP Umbundu-3 wordlist (coarse, orthography-free) corroborates the inventory only. Hand-adjudicated gold in test/umbundu.test.ts (Igbo/Naija no-referee pattern — a distinct documented language, not a clone). Tone (H/L+downstep, unwritten) + cardinal numbers DEFERRED. 🔷 single-source.

name: Zhuang
notes: Standard Zhuang (Vahcuengh, Wuming base), Tai-Kadai, the 1982 LATIN orthography — longest-match g2p, tones as syllable-final letters (z j x q h = tones 2-6) → Chao. NOW ALSO reads SAWNDIP (古壮字, the Han-derived LOGOGRAPHIC 2nd script) via a glyph→Standard-Zhuang-reading dictionary (2412 single-codepoint glyphs from kaikki) routed through the same Latin g2p — 100% self-consistent (za(reading)==kaikki IPA, segmental). 🔷 reference-parity/covered-subset/DEFAULT-reading: polyphonic ~8% of glyphs get a DEFAULT reading (salience proxy: most senses, NOT measured frequency — so 那→naj not the iconic naz), no context disambiguation (no Sawndip corpus), OOV/unencoded glyphs dropped.

name: Standard Moroccan Amazigh
notes: The STANDARDIZED koiné (official in Morocco since 2011), Tifinagh script — a normalized super-variety over tzm/shi/tarifit; no native L1 of its own. The standard-dialect option for Berber.

name: Standard Malay
notes: ALIAS to the Indonesian engine (served_by=id) — a labelled approximation, like bgc->hi. Malay and Indonesian are mutually intelligible standardisations of the same Malayic language, sharing the reformed Latin orthography and ~the same grapheme->IPA phonology; NO independent Malay referee wired, and the documented differences (Malaysian final open <a> -> [ə], some vowel realisations) are accent-level, not a categorical delta. Locked by test/malay-alias.test.ts. If a referee + documented delta appear, replace with a bespoke module.
